How It Works

1

Create Account

Sign up in minutes using your phone number and basic details.

2

Set Savings Plan

Select how much you want to save daily and how long you want to save for.

3

Start Contribution

Click Add Contribution and make your payment through our secure checkpoint.

4

Track Your Progress

Monitor your savings growth in real time

5

Verify & Confirm Payments

Every contribution is verified through SusuPal's payment reconciliation system.

6

Withdraw When Your Plan Matures

Once your savings plan is completed, you can request a withdrawal and recieve your savings.

Track savings goals, contributions and withdrawals directly from your mobile device.
